name: @aexhq/repository
description: Repository for the aex SDK, CLI, contracts, conformance helpers, user tests, and docs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aexhq/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @aexhq/conformance run build && pnpm --filter @aexhq/cli run build && pnpm --filter @aexhq/sdk run build
scripts.lint: pnpm run brand:check && pnpm --filter @aexhq/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @aexhq/conformance run build && pnpm --filter @aexhq/sdk run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 --if-present run lint && pnpm run lint:tests
scripts.test:unit: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 --if-present run test:unit && pnpm exec vitest run --root scripts/validate capability-matrix.test.ts
scripts.pack:sdk: pnpm --filter @aexhq/sdk run publish:dry-run && pnpm run contracts:boundary:check
